title: Products of transforms approach a bell
hook: Two stated cases: explore the standardized independent coin-sum characteristic function.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the standardized independent coin-sum characteristic function affects the stated comparison
